digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective publication seam
propositions: Repository delegation must not blur ownership boundaries between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication seam.
Selective publication must stage only the existing five allowlisted bridge-state files and never publish repository checkpoints independently.
Unchanged passes must create no commit; rotation and retired-first publication semantics must preserve pre-extraction floors.
ADR 0099 must record ownership scope, ordered partial-state behavior, persistence-vs-publication split, and explicit rollback/no-journal/no-format-migration decisions.
Regression test suite must prove five-file allowlist unchanged-pass behavior and rotation floors remain intact across selective-publication seam boundary.
Repository failures must not cause unrelated tracker staging.
